notes.title: Patch 1.2.7
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.7

Fixes 
- Fixed an issue where some words were missing after switching to Japanese language.  
- Fixed a bug where the controller sometimes didn’t respond in the in-game menu.  
- Further improved performance.  

New Features 
- After finishing a run, you no longer lose a life.  
- After a run, you can now select the next level without returning to the main menu.  
- XP and level are now displayed in the pause menu at the top right during a run.

notes.title: Your Best Time
notes.content:
Hey friends,

Map - Forest Run

Today, we want to kick off a small event: the goal is to post your best time on the "Forest Run" map. To do this, simply take a Steam screenshot using the F12 key. Then, upload it to Steam and make sure it’s set to public so it appears in the "Run Higher" section under screenshots. The best times will be featured in a banner on our Twitch page in the info panels.

Steam broadcasts are now also active, and there’s a new "Run Higher" category on Twitch. We wish you lots of fun and a great run!

Best regards,  
Holy Mask Games

- Twitch

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 - July 23, 2024

Changes and Improvements

- Removal of Environment Quality Option
  
  The setting for environment quality in the settings menu has been removed. This change was made because the "Low" setting caused issues with character rendering.

notes.content:
Dear Run Higher Community,

Be sure to check it out and subscribe to our channel so you don't miss any videos
